# --- 1. NO
talk odynp1_teach 10

talk odynp1_declined 10 -
waitctl 900
face UP
# --- 3. YES, Golem
talk odynp3_teach 10
tap A 0

include _pickparty.txt

boxgo 1 0
snap odynp3_party
boxpick 1 1 odynp3_party_golem
include _tofield.txt
pages odynp3_learned 1
talk odynp3_taught 10 -
waitctl 900
face UP
# --- 4. again: the tutor starts over (no flag in H&S)
talk odynp4_again 10
tap B 0
talk odynp4_declined 10 -
waitctl 900
# --- 5. Typhlosion (4 moves) through the summary
face UP
talk odynp5_teach 10
tap A 0
talk odynp5_which 10 -
include _pickparty.txt
boxpick 1 0
include _tofield.txt
pages odynp5_replace 2
waitlearn 5
snap odynp5_replace_yesno
tap A 0
pages odynp5_whichforget 1
waitcb2x pokemon_summary_screen:MainCB2 900
waittaskx pokemon_summary_screen:Task_HandleReplaceMoveInput 900
waitquiet
press UP
snap odynp5_summary_new
press UP
snap odynp5_summary_4
press A
waitcb2x CB2_Overworld 900
waittaskx field_specials:Task_LearnMove 900
pages odynp5_poof 4
talk odynp5_taught 10 -
waitctl 900
